text:
maria: Heads-up — central log search is returning sparse results for long-range queries in eu-west this morning. seen it from both Kibana and Loki. wondering if sampling/windowing kicked in? :thinking:

kevin: yup noticed the same. queries that span >6h are returning ~30% fewer traces. Dashboard shows query latency spike around 07:12 UTC. sre-bot alert fired: central-log-search-latency.

sre-bot: ALERT: central-log-search-latency (eu-west) triggered at 2026-03-18T07:12:02Z. current value: 1200ms > threshold 800ms.

alex: Grafana panel (ingest > shard-queue-latency) shows hot shards on ns=logs-eu-west-hot-3 with backlog. likely backpressure caused sampling heuristics to drop older segments during search.

maria: repro steps I used: 1) Kibana -> Discover -> time range 2026-03-18 00:00 - 08:00 UTC 2) search term `trace_id: "abcd1234"` 3) results missing many events that exist if I query a 30m window.

kevin: can try a Loki query to compare counts quickly. snippet I ran: ```{job="redwood-logs", region="eu-west"} |= "trace_id=abcd1234" | count_over_time(1h)``` counts dropped when window >6h.

jing: two parallel hypotheses: 1) query-side sampling/window folding in the frontend (Kibana/Loki config) 2) index-side TTL/compaction moving older segments to cold store where queries hit the slow path and time out, leading to client-side sampling. we should check index lifecycle policies and query `/_cat/shards` for shard state.

alex: checked ILM: hot->warm transition happened earlier for that index due to accidental policy change last week. hot shard size got above target and compaction started at 02:00 UTC. compaction + high ingest explains backlog.

kevin: short-term mitigation: 1) restrict default Discover max time range to 6h for eu-west (we can flip via kibana.yml) 2) add a temporary routing rule to route queries with `raw_query=true` header to the hot replicas (bypass sampling). I've got a patch ready to test on staging.

maria: can we do a non-invasive workaround for oncall to use? i.e., a curl command that targets the hot replica directly?

kevin: yeah — quick curl: ```curl -H "X-Route-Replica: hot" "https://kibana.eu-west.redwood.internal/api/discover/search" -d '{"query":"trace_id:abcd1234","timeRange":{"from":"now-8h","to":"now"}}'``` that should hit hot pool (internal-only header). use carefully.

jing: medium-term: revert the ILM policy change and re-run a targeted reindex for the last 48h to restore uniform shard distribution. also tune Loki query sharding and increase `query_timeout` from 60s -> 90s for eu-west until compaction finishes.

sre-bot: NOTE: runbook link created -> https://internal.redwood/runbooks/central-log-search (auto-created by bot).

alex: I'll start the reindex job for logs-eu-west-2026.03.16-24 and watch shard queues. ETA ~ 45m. will post updates here.

maria: awesome — thanks. pls ping #oncall if anything spikes. for now i'll use 6h window and kevin's curl if i need deep dive. :thumbsup:
